{{short description|German chemist}}
'''Hans-Jürgen Quadbeck-Seeger''' (born 29 May 1939 in [[Insterburg]], East Prussia) is a German chemist, inventor, and author. He was Research Director at [[BASF]] (from 1990 to 1997),<ref>{{cite web |title=The chemist Prof. dr. Hans-Jürgen Quadbeck-Seeger created the motto of the DFB for the 2014 World Cup |url=https://www.chemanager-online.com/news-opinions/nachrichten/ein-guter-anfang-braucht-begeisterung-ein-gutes-ende-disziplin|accessdate=13 May 2019}}</ref> and President of the [[German Chemical Society]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Prof. Dr. Hans-Jürgen Quadbeck-Seeger |url=https://www.dpma.de/ponline/erfindergalerie/bio_quadbeck.html|accessdate=13 May 2019}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=773 citations by the author Hans-Jürgen Quadbeck-Seeger|url=https://www.aphorismen.de/suche?f_autor=7287_Hans-J%C3%BCrgen+Quadbeck-Seeger|accessdate=13 May 2019}}</ref>

==Career==
Hans-Jürgen Quadbeck-Seeger studied chemistry, physics and anthropology in [[Munich]]. In 1967 he received a PhD for his thesis in the field of [[organic chemistry]]. In the same year he started working at [[BASF]] in the synthesis of precursors for dyes department. In 1969 he became head of the research group in the dye and pharmaceutical sector. In addition to his research activities, he coordinated the company's connection to scientific institutions. Later, Quadbeck-Seeger became the director of the Central Division Main Laboratory. In 1985, the [[Heidelberg University|University of Heidelberg]] appointed him honorary professor of industrial chemistry. From 1989 to 1997, he served as Research Director at [[BASF]]. Between 1991 and 1994 he was a member of the Senate, and between 1994 and 1995 he served as president of the German Chemical Society. From 1996 to 2000 he was a member of the Senate and the Board of Directors of the [[Max Planck Society]]. In 1998 he was awarded the Federal Cross of Merit First Class; and in 2014, he was awarded the Lorenz Oken Medal. 
Quadbeck-Seeger has over 50 patents and authored several books.<ref>{{cite web |title=Hans-Jürgen Quadbeck-Seeger|url=https://www.munzinger.de/search/portrait/Hans+J%C3%BCrgen+Quadbeck+Seeger/0/17804.html |accessdate=13 May 2019}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Prof. Dr. Hans-Jürgen Quadbeck-Seeger |url=https://www.chemistryviews.org/details/ezine/6137811/75th_Birthday_Hans-Jurgen_Quadbeck-Seeger.html|accessdate=13 May 2019}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=75th Birthday: Hans-Jürgen Quadbeck-Seeger|url=https://www.aphorismen.de/suche?f_autor=7287_Hans-J%C3%BCrgen+Quadbeck-Seeger|accessdate=13 May 2019}}</ref>
